name: EverMind
tagline: Self-evolving long-term memory OS for AI agents.
description: EverMind builds persistent memory infrastructure for AI agents. Its EverOS (a.k.a. EverMemOS) is a brain-inspired memory operating system — sensory encoding, hippocampal-style indexing, and long-term consolidation — that gives agents context that survives across sessions and platforms, with multimodal retrieval and agent-trajectory recording. It's a portable layer meant to plug into Claude Code, Codex, and other agents; self-host the Apache-2.0 core or use the managed EverOS Cloud.
insight: Incubated under Shanda Investment Group, the firm of Chinese billionaire Chen Tianqiao.

modelSupport.notes: Portable memory layer across agents (Claude Code, Codex, and more); bring your own models.

edge: A brain-inspired, self-evolving memory OS that's portable across agents, posting strong LongMemEval and LoCoMo scores rather than a single-app store.

references.title: China's EverMind Launches Open-Source Long-Term Memory System
